title: Don't Let Comfort Kill Your Success!
html:
You’re not irrelevant.

No one is ignoring you.

You just got successful, got comfortable and stopped doing the things that made you successful in the first place. And, now, you baulk at the prospect of doing them.

There’s a whole bunch of bollocks excuses I could list here, but you know what they are. You tell yourself them every day.

So, you can either accept that no one is going to know you and continue on as you are because, let’s be honest, life will be ok.

Or, you can swallow your pride and start doing the things that made you successful.

Because really successful people never stop doing the thing. Not once.

It’s a hard thing to face up to. You need to be looking in the mirror when you do and decide.

Comfort.

Or, let’s go BIG!
